papers.title: Generative Value Classifier
papers.summary: Q-learning is premised on learning a function to predict the value of a state-action pair, with the goal of using such a function to guide policy improvement. Most approaches learn this function from scratch using scalar or distributional return targets. This discriminative approach leaves another source of supervision for learning representations unused: the actions themselves. Rather than directly predict the return of a state-action pair, we ask the reverse question: how likely is the action under each possible return? This perspective provides a critic whose generative component is a return-conditioned policy, which can share the actor's architecture. Training this policy supervises the critic with every action rather than with returns alone, and a squared-error loss anchors the critic's Q-value to the bootstrapped target. We evaluate our approach on both offline and online RL tasks and show gains over leading discriminative methods, including distributional RL methods.
papers.title_ja: 生成型価値分類器
papers.summary_ja: Q学習において、状態と行動の価値を予測する従来の判別的手法に加え、報酬条件付きの行動生成（ポリシー）をクリティクに組み込む新しいアプローチを提案する。この方法により、報酬だけでなく行動そのものも教師信号として利用でき、アクターとクリティクのアーキテクチャ共有が可能になる。オフラインおよびオンライン強化学習タスクでの評価により、分布的強化学習を含む既存の判別的手法を上回る性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の手法革新であり、ユーザーのML関心に直接該当

papers.title: Learning smooth dynamics via Kinematic Interpolants
papers.summary: Inferring dynamics from real-world experimental data is inherently ambiguous, as many plausible dynamical systems can explain the same positional observations at measurement times. For higher fidelity modeling of applications ranging from single-cell RNA to vortex dynamics and even flocking of birds, scientific observables increasingly also include velocity estimates that serve to resolve this issue. However, incorporating this rich information in a scalable manner, free of simulation or unnecessary approximations, has remained a difficult challenge. In this paper, we introduce Kinematic Interpolants (KI), a novel framework that extends the seminal methodology of stochastic interpolants to infer nonlinear dynamics across multiple snapshots in phase space, i.e., observables with position and velocity measurements. Empirically, we demonstrate that across several scientific datasets, KI achieves superior reconstruction of the underlying dynamics compared to existing baselines while requiring only a fraction of the training time.
papers.title_ja: 運動学補間による滑らかな力学系の学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、位置と速度の観測データから非線形力学系を推定する新しいフレームワーク「Kinematic Interpolants (KI)」を提案する。従来の確率補間手法を拡張し、位相空間における複数スナップショット間の滑らかなダイナミクスを再現することを可能にする。シミュレーションや不要な近似を避けつつ、単一細胞RNAや渦動力学など多様な科学データセットにおいて、既存手法より優れた再構成精度と大幅な学習時間の短縮を実証した。

papers.title: Don't Retrain, Remix: Adaptation of Web Agents using Mixture Hypernetworks
papers.summary: The web is not static or uniform. Websites that serve the same purpose can look and navigate very differently. Even within a single site, successive redesigns can change how familiar features are presented and accessed. Humans adapt to this by recognizing familiar interaction patterns and reusing what they already know. We give web agents a similar ability with WebMix, a mixture hypernetwork that adapts them to unseen interfaces by composing previously trained low-rank adapters. WebMix begins with a bank of adapters trained on source interfaces. At deployment, a scout agent explores the target interface and summarizes its observations into a compact manual. A lightweight router uses this manual to predict mixing coefficients over the adapter bank, which combine the existing adapters into a new one for inference. Adapting to a new interface takes only a scouting run and a forward pass, without gradient updates on the target. With Qwen and Llama models, we evaluate domain transfer on TimeWarp and WebArena-Lite-v2, and version transfer on TimeWarp. In all three settings, WebMix matches or outperforms in-context learning and LoRA baselines, often matching the average success of specialists trained directly on those interfaces. On TimeWarp domain transfer, it gains about 8 percentage points on average over the best baseline with both models. These gains do not come at the cost of seen interfaces, where WebMix keeps its lead, and extend to version transfer. Adapting to a new interface can therefore rely on exploration and composition instead of retraining.
papers.title_ja: 再学習せず、ミックスする：混合ハイパーネットワークを用いたWebエージェントの適応
papers.summary_ja: WebMixは、事前学習された低ランクアダプタのバンクから、ターゲットインターフェースの特性に基づいて係数を予測し、新しいアダプタを合成することでWebエージェントを適応させる手法である。グラデーション更新なしに、スカウトエージェントによる探索と軽量ルーターのフォワードパスのみで適応を実現する。QwenやLlamaモデルを用いた評価では、インコンテキスト学習やLoRAベースラインを上回り、専門モデルに近い性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と適応手法の効率化に直結する

papers.title: Structure-Aware Spatial Kernels for Gaussian Process Distributed Port-Hamiltonian Systems
papers.summary: Gaussian process distributed port-Hamiltonian systems (GP-dPHS) enable data-driven modeling of distributed dynamical systems while preserving their physical structure. However, standard stationary kernels can be inefficient for spatially heterogeneous systems because they neither exploit known input invariances nor reflect structured spatial dependencies. We address this limitation with a structure-aware kernel design that removes irrelevant state coordinates and decouples state and spatial dependencies through a tensor-product covariance. This modular construction allows qualitative knowledge of spatial heterogeneity to be incorporated by selecting an appropriate spatial kernel without requiring an analytical description of the underlying profile. Numerical experiments on a nonlinear string with periodic, smoothly varying, and semi-piecewise stiffness profiles demonstrate that structural decoupling consistently improves reconstruction accuracy, while profile-matched spatial kernels yield substantially larger gains in force-field and trajectory reconstruction.
papers.title_ja: ガウス過程分散ポート・ハミルトニアン系における構造認識型空間カーネル
papers.summary_ja: 分散動的システムのデータ駆動型モデリングにおいて、物理構造を保持しつつ空間的な非均質性を効率的に扱うための新しいカーネル設計を提案する。標準的な定常カーネルが空間依存性を捉えにくい問題を解決するため、状態と空間の依存性をテンソル積共分散によって分離するモジュール構成を採用した。この手法により、空間的な異質性に関する定性的な知識を解析的なプロファイルなしで組み込むことが可能になる。非線形弦のシミュレーション実験では、構造の分離により再構成精度が向上し、プロファイルに合わせた空間カーネルの選択により力場や軌道の再構成が大幅に改善されることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ガウス過程と物理情報モデルの融合であり、サロゲートモデルの精度向上に直結する手法。

papers.title: Sensitivity Analysis of Decision Rules in an Agent-Based Agro-Ecological Model
papers.summary: Agent-based models are well-suited for modelling agro-ecological systems for decision-making, yet turning their simulations into actionable insight requires identifying which decisions actually drive the behaviours. In such a context, sensitivity analysis stumbles upon a structural feature of many complex systems: the parameters are not a flat vector but a decision tree in which many parameters appear only when a higher-level choice activates them. Classical global sensitivity analysis presupposes independent inputs over a fixed Cartesian product and is ill-posed on such a branched space and biased by construction. We instead treat the structure of the decisions as a first-class modelling object. Using advanced surrogate modelling techniques, we encode the crop-management itinerary of the high-resolution agro-ecological modelling platform MAELIA as a hierarchical design space featuring both categorical and numerical variables. We propose a novel dedicated method to analyse this kind of hierarchical space, a random-forest-supervised HSIC-ANOVA, which ranks main effects and interactions natively on the tree while placing rarely and always active decisions on an equal footing. We show how, when applied to simulation outputs such as nitrogen leaching, soil organic carbon variation, and yield predictions, it can deliver an interpretable, decision-oriented reading.
papers.title_ja: エージェントベース型アグロエコロジーモデルにおける意思決定ルールの感度分析
papers.summary_ja: エージェントベースモデルの複雑な意思決定構造に対し、従来の感度分析手法が適用しにくい問題を解決する。サロゲートモデリング技術を用い、カテゴリカル変数と数値変数が混在する階層的な設計空間を構築する。ランダムフォレストとHSIC-ANOVAを組み合わせた新規手法を提案し、ツリー構造上で主効果と相互作用をランキングする。これにより、窒素流出や収量予測などのシミュレーション出力から、解釈可能な意思決定指向の洞察を得られることを示す。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと感度分析手法の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: Modeling and Analysis of Dynamic Coupling Effects in a Free-Floating Space Manipulator
papers.summary: Motion of a robotic manipulator mounted on a free-floating spacecraft induces base translation and rotation, creating a dynamic coupling that affects end-effector motion. This paper characterizes that coupling in a planar three-link space manipulator. Using momentum conservation, velocity mappings are developed between manipulator joints, the end effector, and the spacecraft base. Singular value decomposition is then used to examine coupling strength, directional anisotropy, and the orientation of the coupled motions. Numerical maps show that coupling strength is invariant to the first joint angle but depends strongly on the relative configuration of the remaining joints. Increasing the spacecraft base mass reduces joint-to-base and end-effector-to-base coupling, while its effect on the joint-to-end-effector mapping is smaller and more dependent on configuration. The translational end-effector-to-base mapping is highly anisotropic in some configurations: its base-velocity ellipse becomes increasingly flattened as the weak coupling mode approaches zero. The principal end-effector and base velocity directions also change their relative alignment across the configuration space, producing predominantly opposing responses in some regions and transverse or approximately codirectional responses in others. Together, these results provide a geometric description of how coupling magnitude and direction vary with manipulator configuration and spacecraft mass.
papers.title_ja: 自由浮遊宇宙マニピュレータにおける動的結合効果のモデリングと解析
papers.summary_ja: 自由浮遊宇宙船に搭載されたマニピュレータの動作が誘発するベースの並進・回転との動的結合を、平面3リンク系で定式化する。運動量保存則を用いた速度マッピングと特異値分解（SVD）により、結合強度・方向異方性・結合運動の向きを解析した。数値解析の結果、結合強度は第1関節角に対して不変だが、残りの関節の相対配置に強く依存し、ベース質量の増加は関節-ベース間の結合を低減することが示された。また、特定の配置では並進方向の結合が高度に異方性を示し、ベース速度楕円が扁平化することや、主速度方向の相対的な整列が配置空間内で変化することが明らかになった。
papers.relevance_reason: 宇宙マニピュレータの力学解析であり、軌道力学とは異なるが機械学習未使用の物理モデリング

papers.title: The START mission: Probing the 2029 Apophis Flyby via a Low-Cost Geocentric SmallSat
papers.summary: The Student-led Threatening Asteroid Reconnaissance of Tsinghua (START) marks the inaugural mission of the Tianxing Program, a deep-space exploration initiative led by students at Tsinghua University. Conceived as a low-cost, rapid-response small-satellite mission, START will investigate the near-Earth asteroid (99942) Apophis during its close approach to Earth in April 2029, when significant terrestrial tidal forces will offer a rare opportunity to observe the physical and dynamical response of a rubble-pile asteroid in real time. The 300 kg spacecraft is scheduled for rideshare launch into low Earth orbit in early 2028 and will then use solar electric propulsion to transfer to a circular mission orbit with a semimajor axis of approximately 38,000 km and an inclination of 55 degrees. START will execute a high-speed flyby of Apophis from a closest distance of 7 km at the asteroid's closest approach to Earth, to capture its tidal response. The payload suite consists of a high-resolution narrow-field camera, a wide-field navigation camera, and three near-infrared multispectral imagers. By acquiring centimeter-scale imagery and meter-scale reflectance spectra, the mission will characterize the asteroid's surface morphology and composition and monitor immediate tidally induced surface modifications. Ultimately, START will provide geometrically complementary, high-cadence datasets to international flagship missions to Apophis, demonstrating a highly scalable and cost-effective architecture for future planetary defense and small-body exploration.
papers.title_ja: STARTミッション：低コスト地球中心小型衛星による2029年アポフィスフライバイの探査
papers.summary_ja: 清華大学が主導する学生主導の深宇宙探査プログラム「Tianxing」の初ミッションであるSTARTは、2029年に地球に接近する近地球小惑星(99942)アポフィスを低コストで探査する計画です。2028年に太陽電気推進を用いて約38,000kmの軌道へ移り、アポフィスが地球に最も接近した際の潮汐力による物理的・力学的応答をリアルタイムで観測します。高解像度カメラや多波長イメージャーを搭載し、表面形態や組成をセンチメートルスケールで解析するとともに、国際的なフラッグシップミッションと幾何学的に補完的な高頻度データセットを提供します。このミッションは、将来の惑星防衛や小天体探査におけるスケーラブルで費用対効果の高いアーキテクチャを実証することを目的としています。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・宇宙機設計に関わるが、ML・サロゲートモデルの要素が薄い

papers.title: How language model agents reshape price competition
papers.summary: Repeated Bertrand competition is a stringent benchmark for algorithmic pricing: in homogeneous-goods markets, standard learning procedures typically select the stage-game Nash outcome with prices near marginal cost. We show that LLM pricing agents can escape this benchmark, depending on deployment decisions. LLMs outperform standard online learners through faster adaptation, but this advantage largely disappears against full-information learners. An extracted surrogate algorithm illustrates how LLMs in specific deployments profit from regularly undercutting slower learners. Agents that post one price every period from raw market histories that include rival prices can sustain supracompetitive regimes in self-play. Agents that periodically emit probability distributions from summarized histories of their own profits instead move toward the competitive region in self-play. Markets mixing these interfaces can generate dynamic regimes in which LLMs establish a high-price anchor and regularly undercut it to capture demand. These regimes can keep both competitors' prices above marginal cost. Deployment choices shape these outcomes, shifting the focus from stationary equilibria to dynamic pricing regimes.
papers.title_ja: 言語モデルエージェントが価格競争をどう再構築するか
papers.summary_ja: 反復ベルトラム競争において、LLMによる価格設定エージェントが標準的な学習アルゴリズムと異なる動的な価格形成メカニズムを示すことを本論文は報告する。LLMは適応速度の面で優位性を示すが、その効果はデプロイメント方法（生データ直接入力か要約履歴か）に強く依存する。特に、競合の価格を含む生履歴から単一価格を出力するエージェントは、自己対戦において競争的均衡を超えた高価格維持状態を形成しうる。一方、自社の利益履歴を要約して確率分布を出力するエージェントは競争的な価格帯に収束する傾向がある。これらの異なるインターフェースの混在により、LLMが高価格アンカーを設定し、それを下回ることで需要を獲得する動的な価格競争状態が生まれることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計とサロゲート手法の応用だが、対象が経済学であり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Spectral Limits of Polynomial Graph Filters on the Long-Range Ising Model Benchmark
papers.summary: The Long-Range Ising Model benchmark (LRIM) guarantees long-range dependence by construction: each label is the node's spin times the spin field convolved with a power-law coupling, so any model's distance from the target is measurable. We prove that a readout whose filter is a polynomial in the adjacency, the linear core of isotropic message passing and spectral graph networks, leaves an error floor that no degree lowers, because the target varies along a level set of the spectrum on which every such filter is constant. Computed exactly, the floor and the best filter of each degree predict two spectral networks adapted from published architectures to within a tenth of a decade. A filter escapes the floor only if it weighs separately the offsets the adjacency lumps together, and must still resolve the coupling across the whole lattice. A strided filter of about fifty coefficients does both: fitted to the training labels, its test error is 52 times below the best published network's. A dilated convolutional network beats the best published result at 256 nodes, matches it at 1,024, and gives the first in-domain results at the three larger sizes, while a Fourier neural operator with its standard modes falls further behind as the lattice grows. At its standard budget the dilated network stays two to four orders of magnitude short of a larger strided filter fitted to the labels. The analysis carries over to the benchmark's second coupling.
papers.title_ja: 長距離イジングモデルベンチマークにおける多項式グラフフィルタのスペクトル限界
papers.summary_ja: 長距離依存性を保証するイジングモデルベンチマークにおいて、隣接行列の多項式で定義される標準的なグラフフィルタには、スペクトル上の等値集合で一定であるため、多項式の次数を上げても除去できない誤差の下限が存在することを証明した。この理論的限界を回避するため、隣接行列が混同するオフセットを個別に重み付けし、格子全体のカップリングを解決するストライドフィルタや拡張畳み込みネットワークを提案した。実験により、これらの手法は既存の公開ネットワークよりも大幅に低いテスト誤差を実現し、特に大規模な格子サイズにおいても優れた性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: グラフニューラルネットの理論的限界と高速化手法だが、軌道力学やLLM推論とは直接無関係。

papers.title: Learning to Be Guided: Shaping Latent Geometry for Classifier-Free Guidance
papers.summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard component of conditional diffusion models, and guided generation performance has become the \textit{de facto} measure of state-of-the-art models. Recent work on latent diffusion models seeks to learn latent spaces that are easier to model with diffusion. However, under CFG, generation additionally depends on how conditions are arranged in the latent space. We study this arrangement under discrete class conditions, termed \emph{class geometry}, and investigate what class geometry allows a latent space to work well with CFG. Under a Gaussian class model, we show that shifting variance from intra- to inter-class at fixed total variance makes classes more distinguishable under noise, and derive a noisy posterior objective whose per-sample descent direction is proportional to the oracle CFG correction. Based on the analysis, we propose Prototype Regularization (PR), a lightweight surrogate for the intractable noisy posterior objective, which applies a cosine prototype classifier to spatially pooled latents. With a controlled training budget (20 epochs for VAE, 80 epochs for DiT), adding PR to an LDM baseline reduces guided gFID on ImageNet from 3.31 to 2.28, surpassing a DINOv3-aligned VA-VAE (2.44) with negligible overhead. We further demonstrate that PR generalizes to pseudo-labels derived from clustering, continuous text-embedding conditions, and video latents. Together, our findings highlight class geometry as a critical factor in guided generation and take a first step toward CFG-compatible representation learning. Our project page is available at: https://maps-research.github.io/cfg-geometry/.
papers.title_ja: 誘導されることを学ぶ：クラスフリーガイダンスのための潜在空間幾何学の整形
papers.summary_ja: 条件付き拡散モデルにおけるクラスフリーガイダンス（CFG）の性能は、潜在空間内のクラス分布の幾何学的構造（クラス幾何学）に強く依存することを示した。ガウスモデルの分析に基づき、クラス間分散を高めることでノイズ下での識別性を向上させる理論的根拠を導出する。この原理に基づき、計算コストの低いプロトタイプ正則化（PR）を提案し、ImageNetでの生成品質（gFID）を大幅に改善した。本手法はテキスト条件や動画生成にも汎用可能であり、CFGと相性の良い表現学習への第一歩となる。
papers.relevance_reason: 拡散モデルの表現学習だが、LLMや軌道力学とは直接無関係

papers.title: Distributed Performance Boosting through Neural Control for Plug-and-Play Networks
papers.summary: We address the problem of improving the performance of pre-stabilized networked systems subject to plug-and-play (PnP) operations, namely additions or removals of subsystems. While distributed baseline controllers can preserve stability after a PnP transition, augmenting them with expressive neural policies can invalidate the formal stability guarantees. To overcome this issue, we build on recently proposed Performance Boosting controllers based on the Internal Model Control (IMC) principle, which reduce closed-loop stability to a finite $\ell_2$-gain requirement on an auxiliary operator. In the distributed setting, this operator is formed by interconnecting local neural operators that exchange information only between neighboring subsystems. We then derive free parametrizations of this interconnection, namely explicit maps from unconstrained trainable variables to interconnected neural operators satisfying a prescribed network gain bound for every parameter value. The obtained distributed neural controller can therefore be trained by unconstrained gradient-based optimization without stability constraints or projection steps, while retaining the prescribed gain bound at every training iterate. We develop two complementary parametrizations. A neighbor-based compositional parametrization uses local coupling bounds, so that after a PnP event only subsystems whose bounds change need to update their gain parameters. A network-norm parametrization instead uses a bound on the overall coupling matrix and can reduce conservatism, at the price of requiring network-wide information. A PnP DC-microgrid case study shows that the proposed neural layer improves voltage transients under topology changes and load variations while preserving nominal closed-loop stability.
papers.title_ja: プラグアンドプレイネットワークにおけるニューラル制御による分散型性能向上
papers.summary_ja: サブシステムの追加や削除（プラグアンドプレイ）を伴うネットワーク系において、安定性を保証しつつ性能を向上させる分散型制御手法を提案する。内部モデル制御（IMC）原理に基づき、隣接サブシステム間でのみ情報交換を行う局所ニューラルオペレータの接続構造を設計した。安定性制約をパラメータ空間に埋め込むことで、勾配ベースの最適化時に安定性を常に満たす「フリーパラメータ化」を実現し、制約付き最適化の計算コストを削減する。DCマイクログリッドのケーススタディにおいて、トポロジー変化時の電圧遷移を改善しつつ安定性を維持することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータと制御理論の融合だが、対象が電力系であり軌道力学とは異なる

papers.title: S-GAP: Stealthy Graph Attack Primitives for Graph Large Language Models
papers.summary: Graph Large Language Models (GraphLLMs) enable powerful semantic understanding and reasoning over Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs), while their semantic reasoning may exhibit vulnerabilities to perturbations in node text and graph structure under adversarial attack evaluation. Existing attacks typically construct textual and structural perturbations in separate stages guided by distinct realization intents. However, this separation results in attack-intent fragmentation, causing semantic incoherence between the two perturbation types, thereby undermining attack stealth and making them easier for GraphLLMs to identify and disregard, ultimately weakening attack effectiveness. To avoid attack-intent fragmentation, we propose the Graph Attack Primitive (GAP), an atomic semantic representation that unifies textual and structural perturbations under a coherent attack intent. By carefully calibrating the semantic composition of a GAP, we can achieve strong attack effectiveness while maintaining sufficient attack stealth. Furthermore, we introduce S-GAP (Stealthy GAP), a multi-agent framework that iteratively refines the semantic content of the GAP. The framework unifies GAP planning and realization and continuously refines this process through surrogate evaluation and textual feedback. Extensive experiments across four datasets, three GraphLLMs, and two attack settings show that S-GAP improves ASR over the strongest baselines by 7.02% on average while producing more relationally plausible perturbations, exposing critical vulnerabilities in current GraphLLMs and motivating more robust defenses.
papers.title_ja: S-GAP: グラフ大規模言語モデル向けの隠密なグラフ攻撃プリミティブ
papers.summary_ja: グラフ大規模言語モデル（GraphLLM）に対する敵対的攻撃において、テキストと構造の摂動を分離させることで生じる意図の断片化と隠密性の低下を解決する手法を提案する。テキストと構造の摂動を統一的な意味的表現である「グラフ攻撃プリミティブ（GAP）」として定義し、一貫した攻撃意図のもとで調整することで、効果性と隠密性を両立させる。さらに、マルチエージェントフレームワークS-GAPを通じて、サロゲート評価とテキストフィードバックを用いてGAPの意味内容を反復的に洗練させる。4つのデータセットと3つのGraphLLMでの実験により、既存のベースラインと比較して攻撃成功率（ASR）を平均7.02%向上させ、現在のGraphLLMの脆弱性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMとエージェント設計に関わるが、対象がグラフ特化であり、効率化や軌道力学との関連は薄い。

papers.title: Veil-Then-Reveal: Protecting PII Privacy via Reversible Pseudo-Anonymization in Zero-Trust User--LLM Interaction
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly process sensitive documents and personal information, yet sending prompts containing personally identifiable information (PII) to remote providers exposes data subjects and organizations to risks from logging, retention, model training, and unintended disclosure. Existing anonymization methods often mask or remove PII, while conventional encryption eliminates the lexical and structural cues needed for effective LLM processing. We present Veil-then-Reveal (VtR), a user-side PII pseudo-anonymization framework for privacy-preserving LLM interaction under a zero-trust threat model. VtR treats remote LLM providers as untrusted and sends only pseudo-anonymized prompts, keeping plaintext PII on the user. VtR first detects PII and replaces it with realistic, same-type, in-vocabulary surrogates before prompts leave the user's device, preserving their linguistic and structural properties. It combines format-preserving encryption (FPE) for structured PII, such as phone and credit-card numbers, with a keyed-hash dictionary and secure vault for semantic PII, such as names, locations, and organizations. Session-specific mappings provide cross-session unlinkability, while user-side restoration reversibly replaces surrogates with their original values in LLM responses. We further introduce a rank-class FPE strategy for dates that preserves format and ambiguity while reducing cipher evaluations. Evaluation on three datasets containing 11,322 annotated PII instances achieves 97.9% detection recall, 95.2% protection of detected values, and 99.9% round trip; 100% of echoed surrogates end-to-end round-trip restoration.
papers.title_ja: Veil-Then-Reveal: ゼロトラスト環境における可逆的擬似匿名化によるPIIプライバシー保護
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMとの対話において個人識別情報（PII）を安全に扱うためのユーザーサイドフレームワーク「Veil-then-Reveal (VtR)」を提案する。従来の匿名化や暗号化がLLMの処理能力を損なう問題を解決するため、形式保持暗号（FPE）とキー付きハッシュ辞書を用いて、意味的・構造的な特性を保ったまま擬似匿名化を行う。これにより、リモートのLLMプロバイダーを信頼しないゼロトラスト環境でも、ユーザー側で復元可能な形でプライバシーを保護しつつ、LLMの推論性能を維持できる。3つのデータセットでの評価により、高い検出率と完全な往復復元率を実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM利用時のセキュリティ手法であり、効率化や軌道力学とは直接無関係だが、実務応用性があるため中程度。

papers.title: Extended J-band spectroscopy of red supergiants: parameter identifiability and metallicity robustness
papers.summary: Red supergiants (RSGs) provide a near-infrared metallicity diagnostic complementary to optical hot-supergiant spectroscopy, but their low-resolution extragalactic use requires tests of parameter identifiability and modelling robustness. We quantify the information content of extended J-band RSG spectra at R=2000 over 1.155-1.340 um and assess recovery of effective temperature, surface gravity, microturbulence, and metallicity. Using MARCS/TURBOSPECTRUM spectra and an emulator, we perform a six-node Fisher analysis and controlled mock experiments, and analyse 21 SpeX spectra of 20 RSG candidates towards Per OB1. All four parameters produce measurable responses, but only 8-10% of the raw metallicity information and 4-7% of the gravity information are independent of the other parameter directions. Extending beyond 1.22 um provides median fractions of 60% of the raw and 66% of the nuisance-orthogonal metallicity information. Gravity dominates the weakest Fisher mode, while its prior choice shifts association means by at most 0.03 dex. Matched mocks recover metallicity with an rms error of 0.04 dex. Standard continuum treatment biases solar-metallicity mocks by about -0.23 dex, reduced to about -0.01 dex by our adopted treatment. Plausible CNO mismatch adds a zero-point sensitivity of 0.04-0.05 dex, and regularised covariance changes association means by at most 0.03 dex. The preferred analysis gives a mean [Z] = -0.10 dex with a star-to-star dispersion of 0.09 dex. Extended low-resolution J-band spectra therefore yield recoverable metallicity and temperature constraints once continuum placement and weak parameter directions are controlled, although the absolute scale remains conditional on the adopted atmosphere and line-formation framework.
papers.title_ja: 赤色超巨星の拡張Jバンド分光：パラメータ識別可能性と金属量ロバストネス
papers.summary_ja: 赤色超巨星の低分解能Jバンド分光データを用いた金属量診断の信頼性を評価する研究である。MARCS/TURBOSPECTRUMスペクトルとエミュレータ（サロゲートモデル）を用い、フィッシャー情報行列解析とモック実験を通じて、有効温度・表面重力・微擾動・金属量の識別可能性を定量化した。結果、金属量情報の独立成分は限定的だが、1.22μm以遠の波長域を拡張することで情報量を大幅に改善できることを示した。また、連続スペクトルの処理方法やCNO不整合が金属量推定に与えるバイアスを定量的に評価し、適切な処理により誤差を最小限に抑えられることを確認した。

papers.title: Author-in-the-loop Agentic Reproducibility Auditing for a Machine Learning Conference
papers.summary: Reproducibility checks during peer review require a shared understanding of what authors' code is expected to reproduce. We present an author-in-the-loop collaborative audit that makes author declarations explicit inputs to an AI agent's investigation and assessment. A structured checklist records reproduction instructions and limitations; a two-stage workflow on GitHub connects agent checks to author clarification, revision, and agent reassessment. The agent separately assesses whether results have been reproduced and whether authors need to provide clarification or make repairs, while human reviewers approve requests and decide whether concerns are resolved. We deployed the system across 36 conference papers and 133 experimental tables and figures, raising 20 issues after human review. Further checks supported closing all the issues, although full reproduction remained unverified in some cases. We further compared repeated audits with complete and blank checklists to examine how author declarations shaped the agent's investigation and assessment. Our work contributes a collaborative workflow and agent design that use author knowledge to guide reproducibility auditing. The conference deployment provides empirical evidence that this approach can help identify and address reproducibility problems through collaboration among authors, agents, and reviewers.
papers.title_ja: 機械学習学会における著者参加型エージェントによる再現性監査
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、機械学習論文の再現性チェックにおいて、著者の宣言をAIエージェントの入力として活用する協調監査ワークフローを提案する。GitHub上でエージェントによる自動チェックと著者への確認・修正依頼を2段階で連携させ、人間レビュアーが最終判断を行う仕組みを構築した。36件の論文を対象に実証実験を行い、20件の問題を発見・解決した。著者の知識がエージェントの調査方向性をどう形成するかを比較検討し、エージェント設計と人間との協働による再現性向上の実効性を示している。

papers.title: Progressive Misalignment Can Emerge from Benign Recursive Self-Distillation
papers.summary: Training models on their own outputs has attracted widespread attention as a possible route to advance AI capabilities. One prominent approach is self-distillation, where a model is trained to match the token-level predictions it would have produced when given access to additional context, such as a cue, feedback, or instruction. However, the safety properties of this training procedure are poorly understood. In this paper, we present a surprising safety failure of recursive self-distillation, where each self-distilled model becomes the teacher for the next round of training. We observe that when a safe model is recursively self-distilled on its own (safe) generations while receiving an additional non-harmful cue, it becomes increasingly misaligned across a diverse set of harmful queries; we call this Progressive Misalignment. We show this failure mode in both the Qwen3 and Phi-4 model families on SORRY-Bench and StrongREJECT. Progressive misalignment also occurs in a more realistic setup, where the fixed cue is replaced by feedback from a simulated user with benign intent. Using a gradient-based method, we are also able to find benign prompts that lead to progressive misalignment when applying recursive self-distillation, showing that harmful training prompts are not necessary for this failure mode to emerge. We hope our work encourages future investigations of the safety properties of AI systems recursively trained on their own data.
papers.title_ja: 無害な再帰的自己蒸留から進行性の不一致が出現しうる
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、モデル自身の出力を用いた再帰的自己蒸留（Recursive Self-Distillation）における安全性の脆弱性を指摘する。安全なモデルが、無害なキューやフィードバック付きで自身の生成物を教師データとして学習を繰り返すと、有害なクエリに対して徐々に不一致（Misalignment）が進行することが示された。Qwen3やPhi-4などのモデルでこの現象を確認し、有害なプロンプトがなくても無害な入力から同様の失敗モードが誘発され得ることをグラデーションベースの手法で実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの学習手法と安全性評価に関わるが、効率化や軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: HeRE: A Novel Benchmark for Hebrew Relation Extraction via LLM-Guided Denoising of Knowledge Graph Alignments
papers.summary: While LLMs demonstrate strong capabilities in English Relation Extraction (RE) tasks, a significant gap remains in assessing their RE performance in low-resource languages, due to a lack of standardized benchmarks. Creating native, language-specific annotated RE benchmarks is expensive and requires human expertise, while relying on translation yields suboptimal, inaccurate datasets that introduce English-centric biases. To tackle this, we propose a scalable, language-agnostic methodology to create RE data by denoising naturally occurring yet noisy alignments of knowledge bases and corresponding texts. We define a proper alignment via a Natural Language Inference (NLI) task, where a relation triplet is entailed by an input text. We empirically assess five denoising strategies, and demonstrate that multilingual models outperform language-specific models in the few-shot LLM setting, while Hebrew-specific encoders remain competitive under NLI fine-tuning and are strongest in the label-free cross-training setting. We further find that prompting in the native language achieves performance on par with or slightly exceeding English prompts, confirming that the pipeline operates naturally in the target language. The best open-weights model, Gemma-4-31B-it (F1\,=\,0.915), matches the best API model, GPT-5.4 (0.921), and reaches F1\,=\,0.844 on a fully held-out, dual-annotated test set. Applying the optimized pipeline, we release HeRE: a novel, massive, 1.5-million-instance silver dataset for Hebrew RE, designed to support data-intensive experimentation and model fine-tuning. HeRE bridges a critical gap in standard Hebrew RE evaluation, while providing the NLP community with a reproducible, language-agnostic pipeline for RE dataset construction in other low-resource settings.
papers.title_ja: HeRE: LLMによる知識グラフアライメントのノイズ除去を通じたヘブライ語関係抽出のための新規ベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: 低リソース言語における関係抽出（RE）の標準化されたベンチマーク不足を解決するため、知識ベースとテキスト間のアライメントをNLIタスクとして定義し、LLMを用いてノイズ除去する言語非依存手法を提案する。5つのノイズ除去戦略を評価し、マルチリンガルモデルが少ショットLLM設定で優位である一方、ヘブライ語特化エンコーダーがNLIファインチューニングやラベルフリー設定で競争力を持つことを示した。最適化されたパイプラインにより、150万件規模のヘブライ語RE銀ラベルデータセット「HeRE」を公開し、Gemma-4-31B-itがF1=0.915とGPT-5.4に匹敵する性能を達成した。

papers.title: CGDT-CESN: Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network for Multivariate Time-Series Prediction
papers.summary: Accurate prediction of multivariate time series requires models that simultaneously capture variable-specific dynamics and cross-variable interactions. In this work, a Correlation-Guided and Dynamics-Trained Clustered Echo State Network (CGDT-CESN) is proposed, which comprises a modular reservoir architecture with each cluster distinctly specializing in one of the variables in the multivariate time series. An innovative reservoir design is proposed in which inter-cluster connections are enabled by empirically observed correlations among variables, providing a data-driven coupling mechanism. Apart from conventional readout training, inter-cluster connection weights informed by correlations are trained, which in turn allows the reservoir to capture time-varying cross-variable dependencies without sacrificing computational efficiency and further improves forecasting accuracy. The prediction performance of CGDT-CESN is found to be superior to that of the conventional ESN when evaluated on two fundamentally different datasets: Twitter information cascade evolution and solar wind forecasting. Also, the improvement in performance is preserved across multiple prediction horizons, even when presented with a low volume of data. By unifying cluster-specific specialization with learned inter-variable coupling, CGDT-CESN offers a principled, data-driven route to multivariate time series prediction.
papers.title_ja: CGDT-CESN: 相関誘導・力学学習クラスタ化エコー状態ネットワークによる多変量時系列予測
papers.summary_ja: 多変量時系列予測において、変数固有のダイナミクスと変数間相互作用を同時に捉えるための新しいエコー状態ネットワーク（ESN）アーキテクチャを提案する。各変数に特化したモジュール型リザーバを構成し、実測された相関に基づいてクラスタ間の接続を設計することで、データ駆動型の結合メカニズムを実現した。従来のESNと比較し、Twitter情報カスケードや太陽風予測などの異なるデータセットで、特に低データ量環境下でも予測精度の向上を確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: 時系列予測の手法だが、軌道力学やLLM効率化との直接的な関連は薄い

papers.title: BOLT: Multi-Bottleneck Bound-Guided Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling with Time Lags and Resource-Coupled Transport
papers.summary: Flexible job-shop scheduling becomes resource-coupled when a scarce vehicle fleet moves jobs between stations, because the schedule sets the transport waits. BOLT (bound-oriented learning for transport-coupled scheduling) builds a lower bound from chain, machine-capacity, and fleet-capacity relaxations. The bound equals the makespan at termination, so its per-step changes form a reward that sums to a constant minus the makespan. Because it never exceeds the attainable makespan, each candidate's bound increase is a proven rise of the makespan floor, which the policy reads as a price. The root bound certifies a completed schedule's suboptimality gap without a solver. On industry-motivated 10-module prefabricated-construction instances, explicit transport coupling outperforms a transport-penalty policy in every tested cell where loaded moves occupy at least 66% of fleet time and in none at or below 56%. Across five zero-shot 50- and 80-module production batches, BOLT outperforms the best dispatching-rule pair on four and the penalty policy on the three with long moves. In the three-vehicle 80-module batch, its mean makespan is 13.0% below the best pair and 4.2% below an hour-budget constraint-programming solver whose proven gap averages 34%. BOLT decides in 2.3-5.9 ms per event on one processor core and re-plans a disruption in seconds.
papers.title_ja: BOLT: 時間ラグと資源結合輸送を伴うフレキシブルジョブショップスケジューリングのためのマルチボトルネック境界誘導学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、車両輸送と生産工程が結合したフレキシブルジョブショップスケジューリング問題に対し、下界（bound）を報酬として利用する強化学習手法BOLTを提案する。チェーン、機械能力、車両能力の緩和から構築される下界の変化をステップごとの報酬として定義し、スケジュールの最適性を証明しながら学習を行う。産業動機に基づく10モジュールのプレハブ建設インスタンスおよび50〜80モジュールのゼロショット評価において、従来のディスパッチングルールやペナルティ法を上回る性能を示した。さらに、1コアで1イベントあたり2.3〜5.9msという高速な意思決定と、数秒での再計画能力を実現している。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習と最適化の組み合わせだが、対象が製造スケジューリングであり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Sparse Autoencoders Can Induce Local Geometry for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting
papers.summary: Catastrophic forgetting remains a challenge in supervised continual learning, as adapting to new tasks causes representation drift and loss of previously learned information. This raises the question of which representational changes should be constrained while preserving plasticity. We therefore introduce Sparse Autoencoder Geometric Anchoring (SAGA), which converts a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) trained at each task boundary into local, low-rank constraints on representation drift. Replay examples specify where the constraints apply, while leading right singular directions of the encoder Jacobian specify which changes are penalized. The resulting geometry is input dependent and can be retained without keeping the SAE for subsequent tasks' training. We establish its local relation to latent code matching, define its spectral truncation error, and derive a conditional bound on frozen-readout drift. With replay and snapshot history, the method achieves the highest mean Class-IL accuracy and lowest mean forgetting among the evaluated ER, DER++, ER-ACE, and SGD baselines on three pretrained ViT-B/16 benchmarks, with accuracy gains of 12.15, 4.79, and 3.22 percentage points over the strongest conventional baseline on CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and ImageNet-R, respectively. From scratch results are more mixed, while rank ablations and geometry controls show that SAE-induced low-rank geometry offers useful stability-plasticity trade-offs.
papers.title_ja: スパースオートエンコーダによる局所幾何構造の導入とカストロフィック・フォーゲッティングの緩和
papers.summary_ja: 継続学習におけるカストロフィック・フォーゲッティング（既習知識の忘却）を緩和するため、スパースオートエンコーダ（SAE）を用いた新しい手法SAGAを提案する。各タスク境界で学習したSAEから得られるエンコーダヤコビアン行列の主右特異方向に基づき、表現ドリフトに対する低ランクの局所制約を構築する。この幾何構造は入力依存であり、SAE自体を保持せずに後続タスクの学習に適用可能である。ViT-B/16を用いた3つのベンチマークにおいて、既存のベースラインと比較して平均精度を向上させ、忘却を最小限に抑えることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の継続学習手法であり、ML全般に関心はあるが軌道力学やLLM効率化とは直接無関係

papers.title: Local Projected Controllability of Nonlocal Continuity Equations
papers.summary: We formulate and study the problem of local projected controllability (LPC) for characteristic solutions of controlled nonlocal continuity (transport) equations on the space of probability measures over a separable Banach space. The task is motivated in particular by self-interacting models in machine learning, whose action can be represented as controlled dynamics of the probability distribution over input data, while the actual output is given by a finite-dimensional vector of features extracted from the terminal distribution by a possibly nonlinear observation map. Given a fixed finite family of velocity fields which may depend on the transported measure, we ask whether the reachable values of the observable vector fill a neighborhood of its reference value. Our approach is to lift the transport equation in the space of measures to an ordinary differential equation on a Banach space of maps. This representation makes it possible to employ the machinery of Lie brackets developed for Banach manifolds, while the resulting sufficient condition for LPC can be formulated directly on the space of measures.
papers.title_ja: 非局所連続性方程式の局所射影制御可能性
papers.summary_ja: 確率測度空間上の非局所輸送方程式における局所射影制御可能性（LPC）を定式化し、研究する。機械学習における自己相互作用モデルの出力が、入力データ分布の制御されたダイナミクスによって決まることを動機とする。バナッハ空間上の写像の常微分方程式として問題をリフトし、リー括弧の理論を用いて制御可能性の十分条件を導出する。最終的に、この条件は確率測度空間上で直接記述可能であることが示される。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習モデルの制御可能性に言及するが、軌道力学やLLM効率化とは直接無関係

papers.title: When Plans Change, Remember: Replanning-Guided Visual Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: Long-horizon, multi-stage Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often require visual information that is no longer present in the current observation. Retaining the complete observation history is computationally expensive and highly redundant, motivating selective visual memory. We introduce RePlanMem-VLA (Replanning-Guided Keyframe Memory for VLA), which turns a policy's own plan revisions into an online memory-write signal. Under receding-horizon execution, consecutive action chunks predict some of the same future actions. RePlanMem-VLA treats unusually large disagreement between these temporally aligned predictions as evidence of a task-relevant event. We first compare 35 disagreement measures across single-task autoregressive decoder-only and Flow-Matching Transformers trained from scratch, then validate the selected signals on pretrained OpenVLA-OFT and $\pi_{0.5}$ policies over MIKASA-Robo-VLA tasks. The resulting detectors achieve ROC-AUC of 0.981-0.997. We then use the selected signals in RePlanMem-VLA to trigger updates to a bounded visual memory, with a robot-masked write filter suppressing redundant frames. In the evaluated memory-retention experiments, RePlanMem-VLA preserves task-relevant observations until the later decision point in 100% of episodes. Real-robot replay data further show that event selection and redundancy suppression extend beyond simulation. These results establish plan revision as a policy-internal signal for controlling what a VLA remembers. Website: https://vika787.github.io/RePlanMem/.
papers.title_ja: 計画が変わったら、記憶せよ：視覚言語行動モデルにおける再計画誘導型視覚メモリ
papers.summary_ja: 長期的なタスクにおいて、現在の観測にない視覚情報を効率的に保持するための選択的視覚メモリ手法を提案する。ポリシー自身の計画修正（再計画）時の不一致をオンラインメモリ書き込みシグナルとして活用し、冗長なフレームを抑制する。35種類の不一致指標を比較し、事前学習済みモデルでROC-AUC 0.981-0.997の検出性能を実証した。実ロボットデータでも、タスク関連観察を100%のエピソードで後続の意思決定時まで保持できることを示した。

papers.title: Deterministic Bounds on Accuracy and Stability of Metric-Space Regression and Classification
papers.summary: Data-driven approaches often face ambiguity in datasets due to sensor or target noise, insufficient information, and noise in the input data. While best-fit machine learning methods can accommodate such noise through uncertainty estimates, they are prone to overfitting and it is challenging to quantify ambiguity of the relation between inputs and targets. We introduce a geometric framework that quantifies this ambiguity through the average kernel size, computed with data-dependent, i.e. model-independent, feasible sets derived from worst-case input and target noise. The framework provides computable, deterministic, non-asymptotic bounds on the best achievable empirical error and accuracy for a finite, constructed dataset, independent of the predictive model class, and applies to regression and classification with pseudo-metric input spaces and metric target spaces. The ambiguity of the input-target relation implies three consequences: an empirical error floor, an accuracy-stability trade-off, and, under standard probabilistic assumptions, a strictly positive distribution-training error gap when training below the accuracy bounds. Under standard Borel assumptions for Euclidean norms, the distributional analogue of the average kernel size is related to Bayes risk as it reduces to the optimal distribution root-mean-squared error times the square root of two. Experiments spanning tabular regression, image regression and classification datasets yield nontrivial bounds on the best achievable empirical error and accuracy on a constructed dataset, alongside descriptive comparisons with model performance on the original datasets. The bounds provide a computable, model-independent reference scale on the constructed dataset and comparisons with model performance on the original dataset are descriptive.
papers.title_ja: メトリック空間における回帰と分類の精度と安定性に関する決定論的限界
papers.summary_ja: センサーノイズやデータ不足による曖昧性を定量化する幾何学的枠組みを提案する。データ依存の可能集合を用いて、モデルクラスに依存しない決定論的かつ非漸近的な誤差・精度の限界を導出する。この曖昧性は、経験誤差の下限や精度と安定性のトレードオフ、および分布学習誤差のギャップを意味する。表形式データや画像データを用いた実験で、構築されたデータセットにおける達成可能な誤差の非自明な限界を実証した。

papers.title: Coverage Cliffs in Off-Policy Quantile Certification
papers.summary: We study when logged contextual-bandit data can certify an upper tail quantile for a policy selected from the same sample. We construct a PAC-Bayes Bernstein lower-confidence envelope for the target cumulative distribution function (CDF), simultaneous over a predeclared threshold grid and all data-dependent posteriors. The resulting procedure, TailCert, uses the envelope's first crossing of level p to return an atom-safe upper confidence bound on the selected posterior's pooled p-quantile (or inconclusive). It can also be used to select a policy under a certified tail constraint. The concentration ingredients are standard; the main theoretical contribution is a matched finite-class certification boundary comparing full logs with their joint weighted CDF indicators at a fixed threshold. On an explicit rare-action class, the required sample size grows linearly with the overlap factor W, logarithmically with policy-search and confidence complexity, and quadratically with the inverse CDF safety margin; the upper and lower bounds agree up to constants in the stated regime. On this class, the CDF reduction hides which actions exceeded the budget; retaining action counts restores the full-log rate. Simulations verify the predicted search-complexity shift, winner's-curse failure of naive reuse, and the power cost of splitting.
papers.title_ja: オフポリシー分位点認証におけるカバレッジの断崖
papers.summary_ja: 記録されたコンテキストバンディットデータを用い、同一サンプルから選択されたポリシーの上位テール分位点をPAC-Bayes理論に基づいて認証する手法「TailCert」を提案する。事前宣言された閾値グリッドとデータ依存事後分布に対して同時有効なベルンシュタイン下限信頼エンベロープを構築し、選択された事後分布のプールされたp分位点に対する原子安全な上限信頼区間を返す。明示的なレアアクションクラスにおいて、必要なサンプルサイズがオーバーラップ係数Wに対して線形、ポリシー探索と信頼度複雑度に対して対数、逆CDF安全マージンに対して二次的に増加することを示し、上下界が定数倍で一致することを証明する。シミュレーションにより、予測された探索複雑度のシフト、素朴な再利用におけるウィナーズカーズ失敗、および分割によるパワーコストを検証した。

papers.title: Embodiment-Classifier Guidance: Transferring Frozen VLAs Across Robot Dynamics without Demonstrations
papers.summary: Flow-based policies such as $\pi_0$ are trained on a fixed set of embodiments, and transferring them to new ones is an open problem. To adapt a frozen $\pi_0$ to a new embodiment without additional demonstrations or parameter updates, we train a lightweight embodiment classifier to distinguish successful action chunks on the source body from those on the target body, using a few calibration tasks. On transfer tasks that $\pi_0$ saw on its source body but the classifier was never trained on, we nudge each denoising step of $\pi_0$ with the classifier's gradient, which estimates the direction from the distribution of successful actions on the source body toward that on the target body. On the LIBERO simulation benchmark with four modified controllers, embodiment-classifier guidance raises $\pi_0$'s average success on the target bodies from 72% to 80% across 12 suite-controller pairs, with a 31% relative reduction in failures (11 of 12 gain; 5 significant after Holm correction). In simulation, guidance is data-efficient, needing few target-body rollouts per task, which makes it promising for sim-to-real transfer, where rollouts are costly. Guidance is mixed on weak wrists and harmful on a locked wrist, when the classifier lacks data or favors infeasible motions. Collecting more target-body data with guided $\pi_0$ can fill such gaps: on one weak-wrist arm, guided $\pi_0$ solved a task on which unguided $\pi_0$ had zero successes in the original data, and retraining the classifier on the guided successes raised success from 52.5% to 70.7%.

papers.title: Generative adversarial networks with Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty quantification for structural health monitoring: Fibre Bragg grating data augmentation comparison in Hawk T1A aircraft
papers.summary: The signal generation capabilities of a novel data augmentation framework are examined in aerospace structures. First, the framework learns class-conditional temporal and spectral characteristics of the measured structural responses. It uses conditional generative adversarial network training and Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty quantification as a Bayesian approximation. This step enables stochastic signal synthesis and uncertainty quantification. Second, the generated responses are rigorously compared against experimental measurements across time, frequency, uncertainty, variability, and feature domains to assess physical realism, statistical consistency, and distributional fidelity. Finally, the synthetic data are evaluated to determine whether they should be incorporated into a supervised damage classification workflow. The framework is validated on the full-scale benchmark dataset from a BAE Systems Hawk T1A aircraft tested at the University of Sheffield's Structural Dynamics Laboratory for Verification and Validation. The test involves acceleration, fibre Bragg grating strain, and nonlinear dynamic response measurements. The results demonstrate that the model accurately captures dominant structural dynamics, it guides on signal use for classification improvement based on uncertainty characteristics, and it provides meaningful uncertainty estimates linked to signal complexity and excitation characteristics. Importantly, the framework offers a realistic generative modelling plan as a robust digital twin component for data-driven structural health monitoring, supporting resilient decision-making for condition assessment in safety-critical aerospace systems.

papers.title: CF-NODE: Counterfactual Spatial Node Intervention for Test-Time Adaptation Under Domain Shift, Evaluated Across Five Diabetic Retinopathy Datasets
papers.summary: Automated fundus-based diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading can substantially expand screening capacity, but source-trained models degrade sharply across different cameras, clinics, and patient populations. Existing test-time adaptation methods depend on entropy minimization or target information accumulated from image batches and streams. These mechanisms can reinforce confidently incorrect predictions and break down when clinical images arrive independently. We introduce CF-NODE, a novel counterfactual test-time adaptation framework for cross- domain DR grading. Instead of trusting prediction confidence or estimating a target distribution, CF-NODE asks how each prediction responds under a controlled intervention on the evidence supporting it. CF-NODE ranks internal spatial nodes using model-derived attention, feature magnitude, and node-set similarity, progressively attenuates the highest-ranked nodes, and uses the stability of the resulting expected-grade response to apply a bounded calibration of the predicted grade distribution. The framework is fully frozen and adapts every image independently using only geometric views and a fixed source-derived prior, requiring no target-derived information or model updates. We evaluate CF-NODE on five external DR datasets under repeated-seed evaluation against TENT, EATA, SAR, and T3A. CF-NODE outperforms all four methods with statistically significant improvements over the second-best method, improves AUC on every target domain, and attains the highest average AUC and macro-F1, delivering stronger grade discrimination together with more balanced recognition across DR severity levels. These results demonstrate that counterfactual intervention sensitivity provides consistent and deployment-ready domain robustness for single-image clinical inference.

papers.title: Source-Aware Dynamic Pricing with Strategic Buyers
papers.summary: In modern commerce, firms and platforms typically use customer features from different sources to personalize prices: some features are verified using seller records or third-party data, while others are self-reported and may be strategically manipulated by buyers seeking lower prices. We therefore introduce a novel source-aware framework for contextual dynamic pricing with strategic buyers in a high-dimensional semiparametric setting, where buyer valuations follow a sparse linear model with an unknown noise distribution. To account for differences in manipulability across feature sources while enabling effective valuation learning, we develop the Source-Aware Localized exploration and calibrated Exploitation (SALE) pricing policy, which draws on verified features to localize price exploration and combines verified and reported features to correct for strategic manipulation during exploitation. Our localized exploration design allows converting binary purchase feedback into unbiased signals of conditional mean valuations, yielding a new population equation that supports consistent sparse estimation despite non-i.i.d. buyer arrivals. Building on this estimate, we develop a localized empirical-process analysis that exploits intrinsic sparse geometry to establish uniform guarantees for nonparametric estimation of the noise distribution in the high-dimensional setting. With these estimation guarantees, we establish SALE's self-recovery property, which keeps localized exploration valid with high probability and leads to a sublinear expected regret bound. Both simulation studies and real-data experiments demonstrate the appealing performance of SALE. To the best of our knowledge, our study is the first to provide a theoretical and practical framework for incorporating information provenance into dynamic pricing with strategic buyers.

papers.title: Noise-Robust Forced Alignment for Spontaneous Speech
papers.summary: We show that forced aligners degrade on spontaneous, noisy real-world speech, and that fillers, laughter, and disfluencies corrupt word boundaries, impacting many downstream applications. We revisit the classical GMM-HMM aligner with upsampled WavLM features instead of MFCCs, explicit phone units for fillers and non-lexical vocal events trained on verbatim-annotated spontaneous speech, and a discriminative projection fitted on clean and noise-corrupted feature pairs to improve robustness. The pipeline is self-bootstrapped from 149h of curated audio without manual or external boundary targets. On conversational (Buckeye) and disfluent (FluencyBank) speech it reaches word-boundary MAEs of 20.6 and 76.9ms, 19% and 17% lower than the strongest of ten baselines. Catastrophic misalignments (>200ms) are 2.7 times rarer than Montreal Forced Aligners (MFA) best model even after widening MFA's search beam, which we show removes a large pruning artifact from its conversational error; event units halve the error next to laughter, while being meaningfully more robust than existing aligners.
